update.releaseNotes:
v5.9.28 - Settings toggle persistence fix
Fixes --- - Parent farming toggles (cold start, multi-run, auto-equip, etc.) no longer reset on app relaunch - Preset re-resolve on load, migration, and bot start preserves user-edited racing preferences - Debounced settings are flushed before background save so quick exits still persist toggles - Drift detection still compares against preset defaults (not preserved user values)
Includes v5.9.27 career automation reliability fixes and prior hotfixes.
